restaurants.name: Inase Yamagata Gyu
restaurants.notes: Yakiniku specialist serving Yamagata gyu, one of Japan's lesser-known A5 wagyu brands. Counter and table seating; booking recommended in peak season.

restaurants.name: Daikokuya
restaurants.notes: Local Yamagata fare — imoni soup, tama-konnyaku, mountain vegetables. Cosy log-cabin interior; reasonable lunch sets.

restaurants.name: Robata Izakaya
restaurants.notes: Traditional irori-style izakaya in the lower village. Skewers of locally raised pork and shamo chicken; Yamagata sake by the carafe.

restaurants.name: Sanroku Restaurant (Zao Ropeway Base)
restaurants.notes: Cafeteria at the Zao Ropeway base station with curry rice, ramen, katsu-don. Quick warm-up stop between ski runs and juhyo tours.

restaurants.name: Konnyaku Banya Tamayoshi
restaurants.notes: Streetside stall selling Yamagata's famous tama-konnyaku skewers (boiled konjac balls in soy broth, with mustard). Quintessential Zao snack for ~150 JPY.

restaurants.name: Mai Cafe
restaurants.notes: All-day café with espresso, French toast, and Zao cheese plates. Good non-Japanese-breakfast option in the village.
